components.css: .ds-plan{font-family:var(--font-sans, Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif);position:relative;margin:0;padding-top:24px;max-width:560px;background:#0a0a0a;color:#a8a39a;font-size:13px}.ds-plan-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:110px 1fr;height:32px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(245,243,239,0.1);align-items:center}.ds-plan-row.ds-active{color:#c9a66b}.ds-plan-track{position:relative;height:100%;background-image:linear-gradient(to right,rgba(245,243,239,0.1) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:12.5% 100%}.ds-bar{position:absolute;top:50%;height:10px;transform:translateY(-50%);transform-origin:left;animation:ds-draw .9s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both}.ds-bar b{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;background:#c9a66b}.ds-done{background:rgba(245,243,239,0.25)}.ds-live{border:1px solid #c9a66b}.ds-planned{border:1px solid rgba(245,243,239,0.2)}.ds-today{position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;left:calc(110px + (100% - 110px)*0.485);width:1px;background:#c9a66b}.ds-today em{position:absolute;top:2px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#c9a66b;color:#0a0a0a;font-style:normal;font-size:10px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:0.14em;text-transform:uppercase;padding:2px 6px}@keyframes ds-draw{from{transform:translateY(-50%) scaleX(0)}to{transform:translateY(-50%) scaleX(1)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-bar{animation:none}}

components.name: Phase Node
components.description: Signature: 11px square node on a hairline spine; fills gold and scales when passed.

narrative.overview:
The whole system is a construction schedule pinned to a dark wall. Week columns, phase rows, flat bars and square nodes are not decoration on top of the page; they are the page's grammar. Being on schedule is shown, never claimed: a gold "vandaag" line crossing a planning says more than any slogan.

The surface is a near-black ground with off-white type set large and light, divided by 1px hairlines. Champagne gold is the one voice and it marks only what is live: the primary action, the active phase, today, small functional icons and the logo arc. Everything is cut square; the user asked for a site "zo strak mogelijk", with as few soft edges as possible, and the build carries zero corner radius everywhere.

Motion behaves like a plan being set out: lines draw from left to right, words rise out of a mask as if being typeset, and everything decelerates on one exponential ease-out. Motion is medium to heavy by request, and always yields to reduced-motion preferences.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground, off-white light type, champagne gold reserved for what is live.
Planning-board grammar: week columns, phase rows, flat bars, square nodes, tabular week numbers.
1px hairlines at 10% off-white as the only structure; no shadows at rest.
Zero corner radius on every element.
Drawn lines, masked word reveals, one exponential ease-out.

rules.name: The Live Gold Rule
rules.body: Champagne marks only what is active, current or actionable. If an element is neither the next action nor the current state, it is chalk or hairline.

rules.name: The One Wipe Rule
rules.body: Champagne Bright exists only as the hover wipe inside the primary button.

rules.name: The Light Headline Rule
rules.body: Headings are weight 300 with negative tracking. Weight 500 is reserved for buttons and labels. Weight 600 is loaded but unused in the build; keep it for rare emphasis inside data, never for headlines.

rules.name: The Tabular Week Rule
rules.body: Every week number, phase number and count is set with tabular numerals so columns align like a schedule.

rules.name: The Schedule Grid Rule
rules.body: Things that represent time sit on columns that represent weeks; nothing time-related floats free of the grid.

rules.name: The Flat Board Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; separate them with a tonal step or a hairline, not a shadow.

rules.name: The Strak Rule
rules.body: Zero radius, everywhere. If a corner rounds, it is wrong.

dos: Do keep every corner square (0px), including nodes, bars, badges and focus states.
Do separate surfaces with 1px hairlines at 10% off-white (Hairline) and use Hairline Strong only on interactive controls.
Do reserve Champagne for the primary action, the active or passed phase, today, small functional icons, functional labels and the logo arc.
Do set headlines in Outfit 300 with negative tracking, and every week or phase number in tabular figures.
Do animate by drawing: scaleX from the left for lines and bars, masked word reveals for headings, all on cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
Do stop marquees and pulses and collapse transitions under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do write copy without em-dashes; use a colon, comma or full stop.
donts: Don't round any corner or use pill shapes.
Don't add shadows to resting surfaces; the action glow on the primary button hover is the only shadow.
Don't use Champagne for decoration, large fills or body text.
Don't set headlines heavier than 300; hierarchy comes from size, not weight.
Don't introduce a second accent hue; Signal Green and Signal Red are status only.
Don't use spring or bouncy easing; everything decelerates exponentially.
